title: Apply only pending PostgreSQL schema migrations at service startup
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: А мы можем сделать так, чтобы при старте сервиса не применялись заново все миграции, а только те, которые ещё не применились?
Я не понимаю: однократного безопасного перехода существующей production-БД на baseline

scope.goal: Change PolyCopyTrader service startup so an already applied PostgreSQL schema baseline or migration is never executed again and only unapplied ordered migrations run.
inScope: Replace unconditional execution of the complete PostgresSchema.SchemaSql on every service start with a durable versioned schema-migration history and ordered pending-migration runner.

Treat the exact committed schema at parent revision a3b0457fc113fc5ef482aabd5c090c3162045001 as immutable legacy baseline version 1; the unrelated uncommitted ix_signals_trader_wallet_id working-tree change is not part of this baseline or this contract.
On a genuinely empty application database, execute the legacy baseline exactly once, record its semantic checksum only after success, and execute only later pending migrations on subsequent starts.

On the existing production database, automatically verify exact legacy-baseline eligibility from the current successful service initialization evidence for build a3b0457fc113fc5ef482aabd5c090c3162045001 plus required terminal schema sentinels, then transactionally create the migration-history table and record the baseline without executing legacy schema statements again.
Reject automatic baseline registration for a non-empty database that does not match the exact approved legacy evidence; do not execute the legacy baseline or mark it applied in that state.

Record a migration as applied only after its SQL succeeds, leave a failed migration pending, reject an applied migration whose stored checksum differs from code, and prevent two concurrent initializers from executing the same migration.
Make an ordinary no-pending-migration startup perform only bounded migration metadata reads and no DDL against application tables.
Add focused unit and isolated PostgreSQL integration coverage, update startup documentation, and preserve unrelated dirty working-tree changes byte-for-diff and outside this task's commits.
outOfScope: Deploying or starting the new build, restarting or stopping production services, or directly creating or updating the production migration-history table in this implementation task.
Applying, committing, moving, redesigning, or creating the unrelated pending ix_signals_trader_wallet_id index or completing RC-20260820-add-signals-trader-wallet-index.

Changing existing application tables, strategy catalog data, historical schema_data_migrations rows, trading behavior, Paper/Live execution, strategies, orders, configuration, or Dashboard calculations.

Deleting or rewriting the legacy PostgresSchema SQL, converting every historical schema_data_migrations row into a new migration, creating a backup, or introducing an external migration framework or non-.NET sidecar.
Silently accepting a partially initialized, unknown-version, checksum-mismatched, or otherwise unverified existing database as the legacy baseline.
scope.periodOrFilter: Service startup schema initialization only; exact legacy baseline is repository parent a3b0457fc113fc5ef482aabd5c090c3162045001 and existing production eligibility is tied to the currently verified successful build a3b0457fc113fc5ef482aabd5c090c3162045001.
scope.firstVerification: Inspect PostgresSchemaInitializer, the complete composed PostgresSchema SQL, startup ordering, existing schema_data_migrations behavior, current production heartbeat/migration/sentinel evidence read-only, relevant tests, and the exact unrelated dirty diff before implementation.

requirements.text: Service startup must execute only schema migrations that are not already recorded as successfully applied.
requirements.sourceQuote: только те, которые ещё не применились
acceptanceCriteria: A durable public.schema_migration_history table stores a stable migration identifier, semantic SHA-256 checksum, applied UTC timestamp, and non-secret details for each applied baseline or migration.
The migration catalog has deterministic ordering and rejects duplicate identifiers before any migration SQL runs.
An applied identifier with the same checksum is skipped without executing its SQL; an applied identifier with a different checksum stops initialization before any pending migration runs.
A pending transactional migration executes once and its history row is committed atomically with its successful SQL; failure rolls back the SQL and leaves no applied row.
A no-pending startup issues no CREATE, ALTER, DROP, data-migration DO block, strategy seed, trigger replacement, or other PostgresSchema application-table statement.

verification.command: Run focused PostgresSchemaMigrationTests under the marked D:\CodexTemp run.
verification.expected: Tests prove deterministic ordering, duplicate rejection, applied-same-checksum skip, checksum-mismatch failure, success-only recording, failed-migration retry eligibility, and zero application DDL on a no-pending second initialization.
verification.evidence: 2026-08-21 isolated PostgreSQL focused run passed 8/8; covered ordering/duplicates, no-replay second start, checksum/unknown/gap rejection, rollback/retry, and pending-only history. TRX was stored under the marked D:\CodexTemp run before protected cleanup.

requirements.text: The exact existing production schema must be registered once as an already applied legacy baseline without replaying its schema SQL.
requirements.sourceQuote: однократного безопасного перехода существующей production-БД на baseline
acceptanceCriteria: Legacy baseline version 1 is bound to a semantic SHA-256 checksum of the exact committed composed PostgresSchema SQL at parent a3b0457fc113fc5ef482aabd5c090c3162045001 and excludes unrelated uncommitted working-tree schema changes.

Automatic existing-production baseline registration requires a non-empty database, the exact currently verified successful service build a3b0457fc113fc5ef482aabd5c090c3162045001 in service_heartbeats, the latest required schema_data_migrations marker, and exact terminal relation/function/trigger sentinels proving the previous initializer reached the end of the composed schema.
Baseline eligibility is verified before legacy application schema SQL runs; an eligibility mismatch stops initialization with a specific diagnostic and records no baseline row.
History-table creation and the baseline marker are committed together only after eligibility passes, so a failed eligibility check does not leave a baseline marker.
Once recorded, later starts validate the baseline identifier/checksum from history and do not repeat production baseline eligibility queries or execute legacy schema SQL.
The first launch against an empty database applies the same exact baseline once and records the same identifier/checksum only after the full baseline succeeds.

verification.command: Run isolated PostgreSQL migration integration tests against an ephemeral PostgreSQL data directory inside the marked D:\CodexTemp run.
verification.expected: An empty database applies and records baseline once; a second start executes no baseline DDL; an eligible legacy database records baseline without replay; an ineligible or partial database records nothing and fails explicitly.
verification.evidence: Ephemeral PostgreSQL 17 at 127.0.0.1:55439 passed empty full-baseline bootstrap plus unchanged second start, exact eligible existing baseline without legacy replay, partial relation rejection, and function-only/type-only public-schema rejection; focused total 8/8.

verification.command: Run bounded UTC READ ONLY queries only against 192.168.0.101:5432/polycopytrader for exact heartbeat build, schema_data_migrations marker, terminal sentinels, current migration-history absence, locks, and object counts; perform no production mutation.
verification.expected: The preview reports exact identifiers/counts and proves whether current production satisfies the contract's automatic baseline eligibility without creating or updating any row or schema object.
verification.evidence: Atomic cutoff 2026-08-21T20:28:08.668978Z on exact 192.168.0.101:5432/polycopytrader, PostgreSQL 18.3 primary, UTC REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY, statement_timeout=15s: heartbeat Running/Live on exact a3b0457fc113fc5ef482aabd5c090c3162045001 with last_error NULL; schema_migration_history absent; required data marker count 1; all four required relations present; exact terminal triggers matched tgtype 29/O and tgtype 8/O with old_paper_positions; application_object_count=797; ungranted locks=0; migration advisory locks=0; lock-waiter sessions=0. No production mutation occurred.

requirements.text: Migration execution must fail closed on concurrency, mutation, or partial-application ambiguity rather than replaying an already applied change.
acceptanceCriteria: A database-scoped PostgreSQL advisory migration lock serializes initializers; an initializer that cannot obtain it does not execute migration SQL and returns an explicit error rather than waiting indefinitely.
The advisory lock is released on success, failure, or cancellation.
Every catalog migration declares whether it is transactional; transactional migrations use one transaction with their history insert.

Any future non-transactional migration must be explicitly idempotent and independently verify its completed database state before its history row is inserted; no non-transactional migration is added by this task.
Initialization logs exact migration identifiers and outcomes without logging connection strings, credentials, or migration SQL containing data values.

verification.command: Run focused concurrency, failure, cancellation, transaction-mode, and log-redaction migration tests under the marked D:\CodexTemp run.
verification.expected: Only one initializer can execute migrations; failures and cancellation release coordination state; no ambiguous migration is marked applied; diagnostics contain identifiers but no secret-bearing connection string or raw SQL payload.
verification.evidence: Focused isolated suite passed 8/8. It proves contention rejection, independent pre-opened-session advisory-lock availability after both PostgreSQL failure and cancellation, transactional rollback, non-transactional completion checks, and suppression of raw database marker/connection string from Console and escaped host exception.

requirements.text: The change must be deployable without altering trading behavior or absorbing unrelated working-tree changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Only storage startup migration infrastructure, its focused tests, and startup documentation change under this contract.
No strategy, order, Paper/Live, Dashboard calculation, service configuration, production database, service state, or deployment state is changed by implementation or verification.
The pre-existing PostgresSchema.cs and StorageTests.cs ix_signals_trader_wallet_id edits remain byte-for-diff preserved, unstaged, uncommitted, and outside this contract.

README documents empty-database bootstrap, exact existing-production automatic baseline, pending-only startup, checksum mismatch behavior, failure retry behavior, and the limitation that unknown non-empty databases require a separately approved baseline decision.
Focused tests pass, the relevant PostgreSQL integration suite passes against the isolated ephemeral cluster, and the complete solution builds with zero errors.
